verses.text: Of David. LORD, I give my life to you.
My God, I trust in you. Do not let me be put to shame. Do not let my enemies win over me.
No one who waits for you will ever be put to shame. But those who betray others for no reason will be put to shame.
Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth and teach me, because you are God my saviour. I wait for you all day long.
LORD, remember your tender mercy and your faithful love. You have shown them from long ago.
Do not remember the sins I did when I was young, or the wrong things I did. Remember me because of your faithful love, because you are good, LORD.
The LORD is good and does what is right. So he teaches sinners the way they should go.
He guides humble people in what is right and teaches them his way.
All the LORD's ways are loving and faithful toward those who keep his covenant and his laws.
LORD, for the honour of your name, forgive my sin, because it is great.
Who are the people who respect the LORD? He will teach them the way they should choose.
They will live good lives, and their children will receive the land.
The LORD is a close friend to those who respect him. He makes his covenant known to them.
My eyes are always on the LORD, because he will free my feet from the net.
Turn to me and be kind to me, because I am lonely and suffering.
The troubles of my heart keep growing. Rescue me from my distress.
Look at my suffering and my pain, and forgive all my sins.
See how many enemies I have. They hate me with a cruel hatred.
Protect my life and rescue me. Do not let me be put to shame, because I come to you for safety.
May my innocence and honesty protect me, because I wait for you.
God, rescue Israel from all their troubles.
